```ts

  tenant: Tenant;
```

### AdmissionRecord

```ts

  Readonly<{
    host: string;

```

One request's atomic registry read, with the host and identity it named.

---

### TenantAdmission

```ts
type TenantAdmission = AdmissionRecord & Brand<"TenantAdmission">;
```

One atomic registry read for one request. Only
[durableObjectRegistry](#durableobjectregistry) constructs it, so lower layers
cannot mint authority.

### DomainRegistry

```ts
type DomainRegistry = ReadonlyTenantRegistry &
  Required<Pick<ReadonlyTenantRegistry, "byDomain">>;
```

A read-only registry that includes the provisioned-domain index.

---

### DurableReadonlyRegistry

```ts
type DurableReadonlyRegistry = DomainRegistry &
  Readonly<{
    admission: Promise<TenantAdmission | null>;
  }>;
```

Read-only native registry, with one-read request admission.

---

### DurableRegistry


### admittedRegistry()

```ts
function admittedRegistry(admission): DomainRegistry;
```

Answer registry reads only from one request's admission. Any other tenant, host,
identity or member reads as absent, so every refusal stays closed.
